facts.fact: The presentation says NCLAS 1 was rolled out to all Communal Land Boards in 2008 and web-based, server-based NCLAS 2 was introduced in 2014 by the ministry, to register customary and leasehold rights in communal areas.
The presentation says NCLAS has two components, communal deeds and communal cadastre (parcel geometries), linked via a Unique Parcel Identifier.
